text:
ana (Eng): Hey team — went to urgent care and the front desk said my member ID on my Redwood digital ID card doesn't match their system, so they billed me as self-pay. Claim#: 995551234. I have a photo of the digital card (shows Member ID 42004200). Anyone seen this mismatch before?

riley (People Ops): Sorry you had to deal with that. Is your plan Redwood Core PPO (RW-PPO-2025)? Can you upload the card screenshot and the EOB?

ana (Eng): Yep RW-PPO-2025. Uploaded idcard.png and EOB.pdf. The EOB says provider couldn't verify coverage and applied full charges.

benefits-bot: Plan lookup: RW-PPO-2025 (UnitedCare). Member ID mapping note: our HR system issues short member IDs and insurer uses a 10-digit member number. Provider portals sometimes expect the insurer-issued ID. Member canonical ID for ana (Eng): UC-0004200420 (please use insurer ID when calling providers).

riley (People Ops): Good catch benefits-bot. Ana, try calling the provider billing and give them UC-0004200420 and the insured's DOB. Also file a member appeal with UnitedCare; attach the EOB and the digital ID screenshot. Want an appeal template to paste?

ana (Eng): Yes please — and can People Ops ping our broker if the provider won't reprocess? I had to pay at the visit.

jordan (Broker): Jumping in. If provider rebills with the insurer member ID we should get in-network rates. I'll open an escalation with UnitedCare if they resist. Typical docs to submit: EOB, ID screenshot, payment receipt, appointment confirmation.

riley (People Ops): Paste this into UnitedCare portal or read to the rep: 

"""
To UnitedCare Member Services,

Requesting review and reprocessing for Claim #995551234 (Urgent Care visit 2025-05-03). Services were billed as self-pay due to a member ID mismatch at the provider. Enrollee: ana (Eng), Plan: Redwood Core PPO (RW-PPO-2025). Please re-adjudicate the claim under the in-network contract for member UC-0004200420. Attached: EOB, screenshot of digital ID card showing Member ID 42004200, payment receipt.

Thank you,
[Member Name]
"""

lee (Finance): If you paid at the time of service, Finance can issue an expense advance while appeal is pending. DM me the receipt and amount.

ana (Eng): Filing the appeal now and DMing Lee. Riley/jordan  please cc me on any escalations. Will update when I get a UnitedCare case number. Thanks everyone :relieved:
